message.content:
Casters are classified in heading 8302, which covers base-metal mountings, fittings and similar articles, including casters. Subheading 8302.20 covers castors with a mounting of base metal, and it splits into 8302.20.00 for castors of base metal with tires of rubber or plastics, and a separate line for others.

HTSUS 8302.20.00 is "Castors", with statistical suffixes 8302.20.0000 (Castors, 10-digit). Subheading 8302.20 is "Castors", with 8302.20.30 for "Designed for use on furniture" in earlier editions. I recall that the structure is 8302.20.00 with the 10-digit statistical number 8302.20.0000, and I am fairly but not fully certain of that.

Note that these casters are for office chairs. Some versions of the HTSUS have 8302.20.00 as "Castors" with a 10-digit suffix "8302.20.0000". Others have a split: 8302.20.30 (with pneumatic tires) and 8302.20.60 (other). I believe the current structure is 8302.20.00.

Because the casters have steel mountings (grip-ring stems) and are used on furniture, 8302.20.0000 is the best fit.

{"hts_code": "8302.20.0000", "reason": "Swivel office chair casters with base-metal grip-ring mountings are 'castors with mountings of base metal' under heading 8302, subheading 8302.20."}
